page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.10xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. It features 40 dedicated physical cores running at 3.1 GHz with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, providing 40 vCPUs. The system is equipped with 192.0 GB of RAM, translating to 4.8 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying on external storage solutions. Network connectivity is supported by a 12 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

In benchmark evaluations, the server demonstrates solid multi-threaded capabilities. The stress-ng multi-core CPU test yielded a score of 38,378.07, while the Geekbench multi-core score reached 12,045.0. Memory performance is characterized by a read-only small block bandwidth of 2,133.36 GB/sec and a large block write speed of 48.09 GB/sec. For database operations, the instance achieved 34.78 million operations per second in Redis SET tests and a PassMark database score of 14,249.04.

Given its dedicated core allocation and high clock speed, this instance is well-suited for compute-heavy workloads, multi-threaded applications, and database hosting. The lack of bundled local storage means users must provision network-attached storage, which may introduce latency tradeoffs depending on the storage tier. It is highly effective for tasks such as software compilation, web serving, and moderate-scale language model inference, where its 192 GB RAM capacity and dedicated Intel Xeon cores can be fully utilized.
